note: Where the pricing fetcher (experiments/pricing_fetch.py) reads published per-model prices. Providers are keyed by the same prefix used in api-targets model ids (google is Gemini, kimi is Moonshot). Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepSeek, z.ai/GLM and Google Gemini pages are machine-readable and their rates are extracted with source_url + fetch-date provenance; Moonshot/Kimi and Alibaba/Qwen render prices client-side, so their rates must be entered by hand (the fetcher records the attempt and leaves them untouched). A fetched rate never overwrites an operator-entered one; verify any auto-fetched figure against the source before relying on the calculated cost. Update a URL here if a provider moves its pricing page.

kimi.note: client-side rendered; rates not in the HTML - enter manually

qwen.note: client-side rendered card layout; no rates in the HTML - enter manually
